_comment: Finishing bake-off (2026-11-09): what the forge's new paint chain does to a picture, per checkpoint. The categories are TREATMENTS, not styles: the same four style_v1 'painted cinematic' pictures, same seed/sampler/steps as style_v1 (so the 1344x768 raw inside each job is the style_v1 render), pushed to 1920x1080 six ways through scene_paint: t0 RealESRGAN only · t1 + refine 0.30 (the forge default) · t2 + refine 0.45 · t3 FreeU_V2 + refine 0.30 · t4/t5 refine 0.30 + FaceDetailer at 0.30 / 0.50 (only the three pictures with people). 4 checkpoints x 22 = 88 paintings, ~1h45m. The question it answers: does refine add detail or drift, at what denoise, is FreeU worth having, how hard should face repair push — and does the answer differ by checkpoint. Read out/bakeoff/finish_v1/across_<picture>_nolora_1001.png (whole) and detail_<picture>_nolora_1001.png (1:1 crop): rows checkpoints, columns treatments. gmic_icon is left out (bake-off 1: wrong for scenes). Needs pull_quality.bat + install_comfy_faces.bat first.
negative: text, letters, watermark, signature, logo, blurry, deformed, extra limbs, extra fingers, low quality, jpeg artifacts, oversaturated neon, plastic skin, extra heads, duplicated figures
